text: Venus has entered your 1st house, and for a few weeks the world meets you more warmly than usual. This is a transit about how you come across. Your manner softens, your humor lands, and people who normally keep a polite distance lean in. You may notice the shift in small ways first: strangers strike up conversations, colleagues do you favors, someone comments that you look well. Part of it is presentation. Venus here often stirs a wish to refresh how you look, and the impulse toward a new haircut, better clothes, or simply more care in the morning tends to pay off now, because attention is already on you and it is friendly. Part of it is mood. You feel more agreeable, less braced for conflict, more willing to let a tense moment pass without scoring the point. Use that. This is one of the better windows in the year for asking, whether the request is a favor, a reconciliation, or a first date, because you are hard to refuse while Venus sits this close to your self-presentation. The season has its soft trap. Being liked can become the whole project, and you may catch yourself agreeing to things you do not want, smoothing over problems that needed friction, or spending the weeks performing pleasantness instead of enjoying anything. Charm this easy also invites attention you may not intend to invite, and a little clarity about what you actually want spares everyone confusion later. The visit is brief in most years, though when Venus is slowing toward a retrograde she can linger here for a couple of months and give you a longer look at the same questions. Either way, the point is not that you become more lovable for a stretch and then stop. The point is that you get to feel what it is like to be received kindly, and to notice which parts of the welcome you would like to keep earning after she moves on. Treat the period as a rehearsal for a friendlier way of arriving, and some of it stays.

For the next several weeks Venus is moving through your 2nd house, the part of your chart concerned with money, possessions, and the comfort of your own body. Life turns a little more sensual while she is here. Food tastes better, your surroundings matter more, and the urge to buy the good version of a thing rather than the adequate one gets loud. Income often perks up under this transit too. Money can arrive through pleasant channels, a sale that closes easily, a client charmed into saying yes, work connected to beauty or comfort going well, and negotiations about pay or price tend to go more smoothly than they would in an ordinary month. The other side of the ledger is just as active. Venus here loves to spend, and the purchases feel justified in the moment because everything you want genuinely is lovely. There is no verdict in that, only a tendency worth watching: the treat can become a habit, and the pleasure of acquiring can stand in for a comfort you actually needed from somewhere else. This is also a period that quietly raises the question of worth. What you are paid, what you charge, what you will and will not accept in exchange for your time all come up for review, and the transit tends to soften the fear around those conversations enough to let you have them. If Venus happens to be in her slow, backward-looking stretch, she can spend a couple of months here instead of a few weeks, and money matters from the past, a debt, a refund, an old invoice, may circle back for settling. Mostly, though, this is a short, pleasant season with a simple use: enjoy what you have. Cook the good meal, wear the thing you save for occasions, sit in your own home and notice that it is yours. Appetite educated by attention becomes taste, and the weeks when wanting feels this vivid are exactly the weeks to learn what you truly enjoy, as opposed to what you merely reach for.

Venus is passing through your 3rd house, and words are the beneficiaries. For a few weeks your daily talk, the emails, the errands, the chats with neighbors and siblings and the people you see without planning to, carries more warmth than usual. You say things more kindly and hear them more generously. Conversations that have been stuck on a sharp edge, especially with a brother, sister, or someone else in your everyday orbit, can be reopened now with a real chance of landing softly. This is a good stretch for any task that depends on pleasant language: writing that needs charm, a pitch, an apology, a difficult message you have been rewriting in your head for weeks. It also tends to make the near world more enjoyable. Short trips, your own street, the coffee place, the school run, the ordinary rounds of your life pick up a shine, and you may find yourself lingering in exchanges you usually rush. Curiosity gets friendlier too; you want to learn things that delight you rather than things you ought to know. The season's weakness is sweetness without substance. Venus here can flatter, agree, and charm her way through a conversation while saying nothing, and you may notice yourself telling people what they want to hear because the harmony feels so good. A few weeks of that is harmless; a habit of it costs you the trust your words are earning. There is also a pull toward scattering, saying yes to every coffee and call until the pleasant noise crowds out anything sustained. None of this needs solving, only noticing. The transit returns about once a year, and each pass is an invitation to remember that liking the exchange is not a lesser form of communication but the thing that makes the rest possible. Speak warmly, mean it, and let a few of the conversations go somewhere.

For a while Venus is moving through the base of your chart, the 4th house, and home becomes the pleasantest place you know. The pull inward is gentle but definite. You want your own kitchen, your own chair, the people who do not require a performance. Domestic projects that have waited all year suddenly feel appealing: rearranging a room, fixing the light, putting something beautiful where you will see it daily. Hosting goes well under this transit, and so does simply staying in; either way the satisfaction comes from the same source, a wish to make the private world lovely and to share it only with people who make it lovelier. Family matters tend to soften now. An old tension with a parent or relative can ease without anyone announcing a truce, and this is one of the better windows for the visit, the call, or the conversation that restores warmth to a strained bond. Your inner weather calms as well. Venus here favors rest, nostalgia in its kind form, the photographs and recipes and songs that remind you where you come from without trapping you there. The shadow is retreat that overstays. Comfort this good can become a reason to decline everything, and a few weeks of cocooning can shade into avoidance if there is something outside the front door you are dodging. Notice, too, whether peace at home is being purchased by swallowing things; Venus can keep a household pleasant by keeping it quiet, and quiet is not always the same as harmony. If Venus stations and doubles back, her stay stretches toward a couple of months and family themes get a second visit, often the same conversation at a deeper level. When she moves on, the rooms stay improved and so, often, does the feeling in them. The useful work of this period is mostly enjoyment: let the home feed you, and let the people in it see you fed.

Venus is crossing your 5th house, and this is the transit astrologers save their fondest language for: a stretch of weeks when romance, play, and creative pleasure all come easier. If you are open to love, this window favors it. Attractions spark more readily, flirtation feels natural instead of forced, and dates tend to actually be fun, which is rarer than it sounds. If you are settled, the transit works on the playfulness of the bond: you remember what you liked about each other before logistics took over, and an evening out does more good than a month of scheduling. Creative work warms up too. Whatever you make, music, food, drawings, gardens, even spreadsheets with a little style in them, the making itself becomes pleasurable again, and pleasure is the best fuel that work ever gets. Children, your own or the ones in your orbit, are easier to delight in now, and their company can return you to a kind of unguarded enjoyment adults are usually too busy for. The season's excesses are exactly what you would guess. Amusement can crowd out everything else, spending on fun runs ahead of the plan, and the flirtation that was pleasant on Tuesday may be a complication by Friday. Venus here also loves being adored, and it is worth noticing when you are enjoying a person and when you are mostly enjoying their attention. None of it is a verdict; the whole point of this house is that delight is allowed. The pass comes around roughly once a year and is quick unless a retrograde extends it, in which case an old flame or a shelved creative project may wander back for reconsideration. Take the invitation at face value. Play is not the reward you get after the serious things are done; for these few weeks it is the serious thing, the part of you that makes anything worth doing. Let yourself be delighted on purpose, and notice how much easier the rest of life runs when you are.

For the next few weeks Venus is moving through your 6th house, and the ordinary working day is where her sweetness lands. This is not a glamorous transit. It improves the texture of routine: the desk gets tidied and stays pleasant, the meeting goes smoothly, the colleague who grates on you is easier to like, or at least easier to work beside. Workplace relationships are the clearest beneficiaries. Cooperation comes more naturally, small kindnesses circulate, and if there has been friction with someone you deal with daily, this stretch offers the best odds in months of resetting it without a summit meeting. Work itself can turn agreeable in a way that surprises you. Tasks you normally grind through acquire a small satisfaction, and adding any touch of care or beauty to how you do the job, the well-made document, the good tool, the pleasant order of a morning, pays back out of proportion. The body appreciates this transit too. Venus here inclines you toward gentler treatment of yourself, food that is enjoyable rather than punishing, rest taken without guilt, routines built around what feels sustaining instead of what looks disciplined. Habits begun now, in mildness, tend to outlast the ones begun in January severity. The weak spot is slack. Pleasantness can shade into coasting, and an easygoing month can leave a pile that some later month has to deal with. There is also a quieter pattern worth watching: serving everyone agreeably while your own needs stay politely unmentioned, until the pleasant helper is privately depleted. The transit is short in a normal year, a matter of weeks, and it asks very little. Its offer is simply that daily life, the part of existence that takes up most of existence, can be liked rather than endured. Whatever you do in this window to make the routine kinder, to others and to yourself, tends to stay in place after Venus has moved along.

Venus is traveling through your 7th house, her favorite territory, and for a few weeks the space between you and your closest others turns warmer. This is the classic transit for partnership in every form: marriage and romance, yes, but also the business partner, the best friend, the person across any negotiating table. Whatever the pairing, the same current runs through it, an increased willingness on both sides to meet in the middle. If a significant relationship has been strained, this window can soften it enough for repair, and the conversation that felt impossible last month may simply happen now, without ceremony. If things are already good, they get sweeter, and time alone together does visible work. If you are unattached and would rather not be, the odds improve, and if someone new is drawn to you during this pass, they tend to be genuinely suited rather than merely exciting. Formal matters between two parties also run smoother: agreements, contracts, mediations, anything that requires two sets of interests to find a shape both can live with. The transit's one distortion is over-accommodation. In the name of harmony you may concede things that matter, and a peace bought that way expires quickly and costs more the second time. It helps to notice the difference between meeting someone halfway and meeting them all the way. Venus can also cast a flattering light, and a new connection formed now deserves a second look after she leaves, when you can see the person without the glow. In most years this is a stay of a few weeks; when a retrograde falls here it can stretch across a couple of months, and former partners or unresolved relationship questions have a way of returning for a proper ending or a real second chance. Either way, the period's gift is the same. You get a stretch in which the other person is easier to see kindly and you are easier to be with, and much of what two people cannot fix in ordinary weather gets fixed in weather like this.

Venus has moved into your 8th house, and for several weeks her warmth reaches the parts of life most people keep in the vault: intimacy, shared money, and the feelings that only surface when trust is real. Closeness deepens under this transit. Where the 7th house is about the partnership, this house is about what the partnership is made of, and Venus here inclines you to open further than usual, to say the tender thing, to let someone see the version of you that is not performing wellness. Physical intimacy tends to intensify too, less about novelty than about depth, the difference between being touched and being known. Money you hold jointly with anyone, a partner, a bank, a family, an employer with your benefits in hand, also comes under a kinder light. Negotiations over what is shared, owed, or inherited go more gently now, and this is a favorable stretch for untangling a joint finance knot that has sat untouched because every previous attempt turned tense. The transit has real shadows because the house does. Charm can become leverage in intimate territory, affection traded for advantage, and jealousy or possessiveness can dress itself up as devotion. Wanting to be wanted this much can also tempt you to manufacture intensity where honesty would serve better. Noticing the impulse is most of the cure. There is a quieter offering here as well: Venus in the 8th makes endings more graceful. Letting go of a resentment, a claim, or a chapter that is over hurts less in these weeks than it usually does, and something in you enjoys the lightness on the far side. The pass is brief most years, though a retrograde can hold her here longer and pull old entanglements, emotional or financial, back to the table for honest settlement. Used well, the period leaves you closer to the people you have chosen and cleaner with everyone else, which is about as much as a few weeks can be asked to do.

For a few weeks Venus is moving through your 9th house, and the far-off becomes lovely. This is the transit of the atlas left open on the table. Distant places call to you, and travel taken now tends to be genuinely restorative rather than merely logistical; if you cannot go, the appetite finds other outlets, the foreign film, the cuisine you have never tried, the friend from somewhere else whose way of seeing rearranges yours a little. Learning turns pleasurable in the same way. Study undertaken in this window, formal or private, is driven by delight rather than duty, and what you learn for the love of it tends to stick. Teachers, mentors, and guides are easier to find and easier to like now, and people from backgrounds unlike your own may play an outsized and welcome role in the period. Your beliefs get gentler treatment too. Venus here does not demand that you defend a worldview; she invites you to enjoy one, to notice which ideas about meaning, ethics, and the large questions actually make your life more beautiful when you live by them. Conviction relaxes into appreciation, and conversations about religion, philosophy, or politics that would normally end in trenches can end in genuine interest instead. The season's blur is romanticizing distance. Everything far away looks better than everything nearby under this light, the other country, the other tradition, the life you would surely be living if you were anywhere but here, and some of that glow is just distance doing what distance does. Enjoy it without signing anything in your heart. The pass returns yearly and is quick unless Venus slows down in it, when a deferred trip or an abandoned course of study may come back around. What the weeks reliably leave behind is a slightly wider taste: proof that your capacity for delight extends well past the borders of your routine, and an appetite to go find more of what it reached.

Venus is crossing the top of your chart, through your 10th house, and for a few weeks your public and professional life enjoys a friendlier climate. People with influence over your work, bosses, clients, committees, audiences, are more inclined to see you generously, and reputation runs a little ahead of effort in your favor for once. This is among the best short windows of the year for anything that depends on being well received: the presentation, the review, the request for more responsibility or better terms, the introduction to someone whose good opinion matters. Diplomacy becomes a professional asset now. Workplace conflicts you approach in this stretch tend to settle amiably, and colleagues remember who lowered the temperature. If your work has any element of beauty, design, or care for people in it, that element shines brightest and draws the notice. The transit also warms the way you regard your own ambitions. Instead of the usual grim accounting of where you should be by now, you may find genuine affection for what you are building, and that affection is worth more than a month of discipline. Two cautions come with the territory. Image can start to outrun substance, the pleasant impression becoming a thing you maintain rather than a thing you earn, and the wish to be liked by those in charge can nudge you into agreeableness at moments that called for a spine. Approval is the currency of this house, and Venus makes it flow, but a career steered entirely by applause develops a wobble. The stay is a matter of weeks in most years, with the annual return offering a fresh window, and the occasional retrograde here can revisit a professional relationship or an unfinished piece of recognition. Take the warm light while it lasts. Let the work be seen, accept the credit without deflecting it, and note which parts of the goodwill you would like to deserve for reasons that outlive the transit.

For the next few weeks Venus is moving through your 11th house, and your social world is where the sweetness gathers. Friendship takes the foreground. Invitations tend to multiply, gatherings actually turn out to be fun, and the people around you feel less like a contact list and more like company. This is a fine window for tending the friendships that matter, the overdue call, the reunion, the small effort that tells someone they are not just a name you scroll past, and for making new connections too: people met during this pass tend to arrive through warmth, a friend of a friend, a group you enjoy, and to wear well over time. Groups of every kind benefit. Teams, clubs, communities, causes, any collective you belong to becomes easier to work within, and if you have been the odd one out somewhere, this stretch offers a natural re-entry. Venus here also touches the part of you that hopes. Your wishes for the future, the ones that sit behind the practical goals, feel closer and more legitimate now, and talking about them with people who like you is one of the transit's quiet gifts, because friends often see a way forward that you cannot. The season's soft spots are mild but real. Wanting the group's affection can tempt you into shapes that fit the group better than they fit you, and a full calendar can impersonate a full life for weeks at a time before the difference shows. Popularity is pleasant; it is not the same as belonging, and this transit gives you enough of both to learn to tell them apart. The visit is brief in an ordinary year and comes around annually, and when Venus lingers through a retrograde, old friends have a way of resurfacing, sometimes to be restored, sometimes to be released with thanks. Either outcome suits the house. You end the period knowing a little more clearly who your people are, and liking them, which is the whole point.

Venus has slipped into your 12th house, the quietest room in your chart, and for a few weeks her pleasures turn private. The social appetite thins. Evenings alone start to sound better than parties, and the affection you do want is the low-lit kind: one person, soft conversation, no audience. There is nothing wrong with you during this withdrawal; the transit simply moves the source of enjoyment inward, and solitude, rest, music, long walks, and time near water or quiet green places feed you more than company does right now. Compassion widens too. You feel other people's aches more easily, including strangers', and kindness done without anyone knowing carries a particular satisfaction in this period, as if the secrecy were part of the sweetness. Creative and spiritual life often stir here. Images, dreams, and half-formed longings become vivid, and work that draws on the inner world, art, healing, care for someone who cannot repay it, goes unusually deep. The house has its fog. Affection can turn covert now, the attraction kept hidden, the attachment to someone unavailable, the giving that quietly hopes to be owed, and feelings denied daylight tend to grow strange shapes. Escapism also gets more tempting when comfort turns inward, and the line between rest and hiding can blur by the third week. Naming what you feel, to yourself or to one trusted person, keeps the tenderness of this transit from curdling into secrecy. When Venus stalls and retraces her steps here, the inward season stretches longer, and old griefs or loves may surface asking to be felt all the way through, which is their way of leaving. In the ordinary year the pass is short, and it ends with Venus crossing into your 1st house, where the warmth turns outward again. Treat these weeks as the exhale before that: the heart doing its filing, deciding what it still loves, and letting the rest go with more grace than you expected to have.
